title: Nutrition and Athletic Performance: joint position statement of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, Dietitians of Canada and the American College of Sports Medicine
claims: For sustained or intermittent exercise longer than 90 minutes, the position statement recommends 10 to 12 grams of carbohydrate per kilogram of body mass per day during the 36 to 48 hours before exercise.
The carbohydrate intake framework advises 30 to 60 grams per hour for exercise lasting 1 to 2.5 hours and up to 90 grams per hour for exercise longer than 2.5 hours.
Carbohydrate loading is presented as a strategy for events longer than 90 minutes, not for shorter sessions.
The statement recommends that athletes seek individualised advice from a registered sports dietitian rather than applying general targets unchanged.
